facts.fact: INTIC says the elaboration of the National Digital Transformation Strategy is included in the Government's Five-Year Programme 2025-2029, approved by the Assembly of the Republic through Resolution 17/2025 of 14 May.

INTIC's chair officially launched the process of drafting the Mozambique Digital Transformation Strategy on 12 February 2026, covering public governance, the digital economy, citizen services and infrastructure.
